about: Frozen attacker model configuration for P2-3. The responder keeps the top-level DeepSeek model; this block is the requester (attacker) model, carried by SharedEval's actors.requester.model (b43acc3, forward-ported onto 7f409da). Both actors reach the same gateway endpoint; the dedicated key created for the run must permit both models, one upstream each, and nothing else.

responder.note: byte-identical (as a model block) to P1-6's MODEL (gen.py; lane MANIFEST.model): pinned to Relace, 300 s attempt timeout; served model asserted on every call

attacker.family: different-family (not DeepSeek, not the NET judge's family); not claimed stronger
attacker.temperature_note: the responder stays at 0; the attacker runs at 1.0 so the two replicates are two attacks, not near-copies
attacker.reasoning_note: fixed and recorded: Gemini bills reasoning tokens at the output price, so the budget is pinned, not left to the pilot
attacker.providerRouting_note: pinned to the single OpenRouter provider 'google-ai-studio' serving gemini-2.5-flash through the gateway, chosen from the public endpoints list (evidence/v3.14/multi-adaptive/upstream_check/endpoints.json; host: prefer google-vertex, alternative google-ai-studio). SharedEval records OpenRouter's display name, so the per-call check compares it to this slug through PROVIDER_ALIASES (delivery_adaptive.py).
attacker.attemptTimeoutMs_note: the same per-attempt deadline as the responder (P1-6's 300 s), so neither seat times out on a slower upstream

attacker_inputs.target_policy_shown_to_attacker: D2R_ID_R0 (the policy the responder runs: the verified-caller header naming the stranger, plus the D2 body); makes the attacker defence-aware
attacker_inputs.persona_files: agents/tina (the colleague's genuine files; impersonation is the baseline identity, not a selected tactic; stated in the paper scope per R1)
attacker_inputs.tactics_menu_note: inlined into frozen/HEARTBEAT.md (the runtime mounts only four workspace files); the menu source is frozen/sources/menu.md and a copy is kept at frozen/menu.md for the supplement
